narrative.details:
The Stormpike dwarves are using the Irondeep mine as a storage depot.  I want you to raid that mine and bring me its supplies.  This will curtail the Stormpikes' efforts in Alterac Valley, and will provide us with needed equipment!

Be wary, adventurer.  The Irondeep mine is deep in Alliance territory, and control of the mine is as shifting as the snows of Alterac.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.
narrative.offerRewardText: You got them! Nicely done, adventurer! And I hope you saw a few dwarves during your raid, and shed their blood for the Frostwolves!
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you enter the Irondeep mine, adventurer? Did you raid its supplies?
